identity.name: Premium Times
identity.description: A Nigerian online newspaper known for investigative reporting, public accountability, politics, business and coverage of West African affairs.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Published by Premium Times Services Limited. Nasiru Abubakar Abdullahi is identified as chairman; the newsroom is known for independent, donor-supported investigative work.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Independent Nigerian newsroom with a strong investigative and public-accountability record; commercial ownership but no evidence of state control.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates Premium Times Left-Center with Mostly Factual reporting; its accountability agenda emphasises corruption, inequality and rights.

economicPerspective.evidence: Business coverage is secondary and framed through accountability, regulation and development.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Nigerian national and West African lens with a strong public-accountability orientation.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting Mostly Factual and credibility Medium; strong investigations but variable editorial capacity and funding pressures.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Left-Center; factual reporting Mostly Factual; credibility Medium (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Nigerian accountability journalism with a strong investigative and anti-corruption lens, useful for West African governance stories.

selectionRationale: Adds Nigerian investigative capacity and a West African perspective that complements South African and global sources.

research.researchNotes: Homepage accessible rather than a dedicated About page. Ownership and chairman from Wikipedia and corporate references. Feed validated. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
